Substep timing (every PhysicsWorldStep frame in the window: 9,798 frames, consecutive outer counters, all with complete ordinals 0..count-1; 14,752 substeps): count histogram 1: 5,016, 2: 4,620, 3: 153, 4: 8, 5: 1. No 8 was seen here (the earlier receipt saw one 8-substep group). dt (+0x1394) was the same for all substeps of a frame and equalled float32(consumed +0x136c / count) in 9,798 of 9,798 frames. dt range 0.0062501-0.016657 (median 0.00942); consumed range 0.0078-0.0407. dt is continuous (9,244 distinct bit patterns), not a fixed step.

Per count: count 1 consumed 0.0078-0.01666; count 2 consumed 0.0125-0.0249 (dt 0.00625-0.01245); count 3 consumed 0.0209-0.0331; count 4 0.0294-0.0398; count 5 0.0407. Observed dt never fell below 0.00625 (1/160) or exceeded 1/60, but count-1 and count-2 consumed ranges overlap (0.0125-0.01666), so the count is not a pure function of the current consumed interval; the selection rule (history/hysteresis) is not recovered here.

Step-hold: all 3 holds were host-paused with the host step unchanged before/after, and the plugin's substep counter did not change during the read; the held settings words equalled the detour reads. Hold timing words: count 1 / dt 0.0107603 (spawn), count 1 / dt 0.0119738, count 2 / dt 0.0077650 (consumed 0.0155300) - the last frame's values persist while held.

Identity/restore: image base, 18b8fa0, 1389a50 loop, 140b1a0, 18ae2b0, 12af2d0 and 19414b0 bytes, broad-phase vtable (34 slots), controller and settings vtables all verified before install; per call both return addresses (18ae2b9, 1389b02), [[[timing]]+8] == controller and ordinal < count held on 14,752 of 14,752 calls; 0 foreign calls; broad-phase vtable pointer restored by compare-exchange and read back original; hook drained; launcher restored settings and saves, stopped the bottle and verified the original DLL.
limits: One 130 s session, one spawn and descent line, one build under Wine on macOS; frame pacing (and so the count/dt distribution) depends on this host's frame rate and is not a property of the original engine on other hardware.

Settings were read sequentially (not atomically) from inside the step and from the plugin thread while held; no change was ever observed, but setter activity in modes not exercised (menus, other maps, cutscenes, fast travel) was not covered.

The timing pointer and loop index were taken from the 18b8fa0 caller frame (saved rbx / pushed rdi of 1389a50), justified by verified code bytes and per-call return-address and controller checks; this is a frame-layout interpretation for this build only.
Meanings of +0x14, +0x18, +0x1c, +0x2c..+0x44 beyond their solver-context destinations remain unassigned; this receipt gives values only.
